description: Make an MP4 (up to 90 seconds) from scenes: each scene is a filled image template or an https photo, shown for some seconds with a slow zoom or pan, joined by fades, with optional music. Returns a job id at once; call video_status with it until the status is done (usually 15 to 60 seconds) to get the MP4 link. Costs half a credit per second, rounded up.

audio_url.description: Optional https MP3, M4A, AAC or WAV, trimmed to the video.

image_url.description: An https photo, instead of a template.

template.description: Template id from list_templates. Every template in one video must be the same size.

name: render_video
title: Make a short video
